thread:
Anna: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a thin translation layer at the edge to accept legacy /v1/generate and emit /v2/chat/stream so older SDKs keep working. Thoughts?

Raj: Sketch the transform pls. streaming vs non-stream differences worry me.

Anna: Plan: wrap `input` -> messages: [{role:\"user\", content: input}] and upgrade to streaming frames. If client didn't opt-in to stream, sidecar can buffer and return final JSON. Tradeoffs: latency and memory.

Sasha: Buffering is risky. Long outputs could OOM edge. Options: 1) force stream and send partial frames (might break sync clients), 2) route non-stream calls to non-stream runtime.

Mike: Forcing stream breaks a bunch of clients. Routing to non-stream duplicates code paths and increases infra. Suggest tenant opt-in flag: compat_generate_mode = stream|buffered|passthrough.

Raj: +1 opt-in. Add header `x-rwi-compat: generate-v1` for telemetry so we can measure perf impact.

Anna: Also add per-tenant concurrency/rate guards at gateway to avoid amplification when we fanout or buffer.

Sasha: Observability: tag spans with compat_transform=true & transform_type=wrap-to-chatstream. Also add a sampling override to ensure we get enough examples.

Mike: Security note: strip deprecated headers (X-Old-Session, X-Legacy-Auth) unless tenant explicitly allows them. Avoid leaking client metadata into system prompts.

Anna: POC envoy snippet I wrote:

```
route:
  match: { prefix: "/v1/generate" }
  action:
    cluster: edge-compat
    request_headers_to_add:
      - name: "x-rwi-compat"
        value: "generate-v1"
```

Sasha: Where does the translator live? In-gateway gives perf but increases gateway complexity. Sidecar/service is slower but easier to iterate.

Anna: Leaning sidecar per-region + a fast-path in gateway for pure pass-through cases. Sidecar can own buffering policy and tenant opt-in control.

Raj: Rollout plan: feature flag by tenant id. Start with internal + 3 trusted customers, 48h watch, then 25%, 50%, full.

Mike: Need a panic button at routing layer to disable translations per-tenant. Also auto-rollback if p50 latency > 20% or error rate > 0.5% post-translation.

deploy-bot: deploy starting: edge-compat sidecar v0.1 -> us-east-1; canary tenants: [redwood-internal]

Anna: I'll write a short runbook and an eval prompt set to verify outputs match for common prompts. Draft RFC link: https://go/repo/edge-compat-proposal (WIP)

Raj: Note: cache keys must include compat marker so we don't reuse incompatible kv-warm caches. Add suffix `_compat_v1wrap`.

Sasha: Also confirm billing: count tokens on upstream request shape to keep cost accounting stable.

Mike: Raj — can you run a spike to measure added latency for small messages? We need numbers before canary.

Raj: Yep, will do today and report back here. :thumbsup:

Anna: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for rollout notes. :party_parrot:
